summary: Iteration 105: Friendship Day Workshop feature (landing page + Cashfree payment + Admin CRM tab). All 19 backend pytest tests PASSED. Age bound inconsistency: backend allows 3-25 but PRD/UI says 6-14. Tighten Pydantic Field to match business rule.
Poster image URL should be moved to env/config or removed from code — currently hardcoded broken URL in FriendshipDayLanding.jsx.
